title: Surjectivity of a coherent formal-system map is detected modulo the ideal
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal. A morphism $(\mathcal F_n)\to(\mathcal G_n)$ in the category $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], which is abelian [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian] in the sense of [def-sp-abelian], is an epimorphism if and only if its component $\mathcal F_1\to\mathcal G_1$ is an epimorphism in the category of modules.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 087Y (lemma-inverse-systems-surjective), with the affine proof indicated there via Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine) and Algebra Lemma 00MB (Nakayama)
